R1.description: A restricted-read permissions profile, layout, environment and codex exec argv for a tester-shaped Codex run, built in a new module with the reviewer's launch untouched (C10g-1)

R2.description: An argv check refuses a tester launch that omits a pinned item or carries -s, an unpinned override or a banned flag; offline tests cover the builder and the unchanged reviewer (C10g-1)

R3.description: A probe set, one real attempt per boundary (clone write, write outside scratch, real-home read, environment, push, gh, network), with a fail-closed judge and recorded known limits (C10g-1)

R4.description: Opt-in live tests prove the boundaries through codex sandbox and through codex exec on the pinned build, and the measured results are recorded in a capture file (C10g-1)

R5.description: The development and harness guides and the roadmap describe the sandbox, its proof, the opt-in command and the limits (C10g-1)
